parsed.name: Sunpower CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
parsed.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT 是用于实验室低温冷却的闭循环低温制冷机，可提供稳定的低温冷头温度，并支持温度或功率控制以满足低温实验需求。
parsed.description_en: The Sunpower CryoTel GT is a closed‑cycle cryocooler for laboratory cryogenic cooling, providing a stable cold head temperature with temperature or power control for low‑temperature experiments.
